focus_signal_excessive_movement: You moved around a fair amount — sudden head movement showed up in about {{pct}}% of frames. A calmer posture can read as more composed.

focus_signal_face_not_visible: You were out of frame for about {{pct}}% of the interview — try to stay centered in the camera.
focus_signal_multiple_faces: Someone else appeared in frame for about {{pct}}% of the interview.

free_sessions_remaining: Осталась {{count}} бесплатная сессия в этом месяце
free_sessions_remaining_plural: Осталось {{count}} бесплатных сессий в этом месяце
